scopeNotes: Annual (-15%) prices not formally encoded (monthly + Enterprise floor only); annual figures live in tier value descriptions.
Add-on PRICES ($29 seat / $149 site / $199 standard) are description-level, not rules.
Price card is Part 17.2 v2 — regenerate this policy if the card changes (finance control).

types.name: PlanTier
types.description: Cumplify pricing tier (Part 17.2 price card v2).

values.description: Launch: $449/mo ($382/mo annual), any 1 standard, 5 Full seats + unlimited Worker
IMS Pro: $949/mo ($807/mo annual), all 3 standards, 15 Full seats + unlimited Worker
Enterprise: from $2,250/mo (annual only), all 3 standards + multi-site, custom seat bands

types.name: FeatureGate
types.description: Plan-gated capability. Feature sets are cumulative: IMS Pro includes all Launch features; Enterprise includes all IMS Pro features.

values.description: Core agents for the licensed scope
Unlimited free Worker seats (5.4 protection — never seat-gated on any tier)

rules.expression: (=> (and (= plan LAUNCH) feature_available) (or (= feature CORE_AGENTS) (= feature FORMS_STUDIO) (= feature ESIGNATURE) (= feature AUDIT_TRAIL) (= feature UNLIMITED_WORKER_SEATS) (= feature GUEST_AUDITOR_SEATS) (= feature CONTRACTOR_SEATS)))

(=> (and (= plan IMS_PRO) feature_available) (or (= feature CORE_AGENTS) (= feature FORMS_STUDIO) (= feature ESIGNATURE) (= feature AUDIT_TRAIL) (= feature UNLIMITED_WORKER_SEATS) (= feature GUEST_AUDITOR_SEATS) (= feature CONTRACTOR_SEATS) (= feature ALL_THREE_STANDARDS) (= feature FULL_AGENT_ROSTER) (= feature BULK_MIGRATION_AI_MAPPING) (= feature CAPA_TOOLKIT) (= feature TRUST_CENTER) (= feature PARTNER_COLLABORATION)))

variables.name: plan
variables.description: The pricing tier the agent's statement is about.

variables.name: feature
variables.description: The capability the statement claims is included or excluded.

variables.name: feature_available
variables.description: True if the statement claims the feature IS included in the plan; false if it claims the feature is NOT included.

variables.name: included_full_seats
variables.description: The number of INCLUDED Full seats the statement attributes to the plan (extra seats purchasable at $29/mo are not included seats).

variables.name: standards_included
variables.description: How many ISO standards the statement says the plan covers (9001/14001/45001).

variables.name: has_addon_extra_standard
variables.description: True if the scenario includes the $199/mo additional-standard add-on available on Launch.

variables.name: monthly_price_usd
variables.description: The monthly (non-annual) price in USD the statement attributes to the plan.

variables.name: worker_seats_unlimited
variables.description: True if the statement says Worker seats are unlimited/free; false if it claims Worker seats are limited or paid.
